title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → FinAidAward
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models. For SaaS reads, map these logical columns to the equivalent Ethos resource fields; for SaaS write-back use the reverse bridge in bridge/banner-saas/.

source_tables.description: Applicant Award by Aid Year. Award record — fund, offered/accepted/paid amounts, status, aid year.
Fund Base. Financial aid fund attributes — fund type, source, need/merit indicators.
Fund Type validation. Aid fund type codes.
Fund Management by Aid Year. Fund aid-year budget and rules. FLAG: confirm table for aid-year fund management.
